job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. Your responses to the following questions will be part of the formal examination for the job of Principal Executive Assistant. Your responses should be an accurate statement of your education and experience. Any falsification or misrepresentation of your qualifications will be grounds for disqualification and bar from future examinations. Please indicate "Yes" to show that you have read this item. Options: Yes | No
02. In 100 words or less, briefly describe how your college education has prepared you for this job.
03. In 100 words or less, briefly describe any training, workshops, or other types of continuing development that have strengthened your skills for this job.
04. In 100 words or less, briefly summarize your experience performing secretarial duties for a senior executive in a school district or county office of education.
05. In 100 words or less, briefly summarize your experience interacting with public officials.
06. In 100 words or less, briefly summarize your experience planning and coordinating organizational events.
07. In 100 words or less, briefly describe your experience gathering organizational information and compiling reports.
08. In 100 words or less, briefly describe your experience leading, coaching, and developing others.
